description: Public Service Commission Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals Service 5th Amendemt
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the Sri Lanka Principals Service regulations, specifically dealing with recruitment procedures, promotion criteria, efficiency bar examinations, and service conditions. These are public sector service administration matters related to recruitment, examinations, and service conditions for public servants (principals), which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The content does not involve government structural changes, individual personnel appointments, land matters, legal frameworks, commercial activities, elections, or judicial appointments.
